rationale: FAMILY CONTRACT: qualified_calls entries are dotted call paths WITHOUT argument text (java convention; consumers exact-match dotted names). Chained calls previously embedded inner-call arguments (`db.list(user).map`), breaking path matching. SCD7 (M37 #598): the push runs AFTER the curried-application guard — `self.add(1)(2)` previously double-pushed "self.add" (outer wrapper + inner call). countEquals pins the exact multiplicity; includes alone pass on a doubled array.
